profile.longBio:
I'm a full-stack JavaScript developer based in Kolkata, India. I work across React interfaces, Express APIs and MongoDB data models to build practical web applications.

My GitHub projects include StoreX for inventory and business operations, KING'S TEA for e-commerce, SkillBridge for customer and worker workflows, and TOSIF OS for portfolio content and personal productivity. KING'S TUTOR explores tutoring workflows as a frontend prototype.

I focus on clear user experiences and maintainable code, and continue learning through hands-on projects.

My practical training includes a MERN-stack internship at Web Guru Infosystem in Kolkata (September-November 2024) and a 60-hour Data Science with Python internship at AICT (June-July 2026). At AICT, I built a Fake News Detection training project using NLP and TF-IDF and earned O grade in the associated industrial training course.

I currently work as a Jr. Web Developer (Backend) at RIZ Software Consultancy in Kolkata, having joined on 16 September 2026.

paragraphs: I'm a full-stack JavaScript developer based in Kolkata, India. I work across React interfaces, Express APIs and MongoDB data models to build practical web applications.

My projects cover business operations in StoreX, e-commerce in KING'S TEA, customer and worker workflows in SkillBridge, and content management in TOSIF OS. KING'S TUTOR is a frontend prototype for tutoring workflows.
I enjoy working from a clear interface through backend routes and data models. My public repositories document both the implementation and its scope.

My practical training includes a MERN-stack internship at Web Guru Infosystem in Kolkata (September-November 2024) and a 60-hour Data Science with Python internship at AICT (June-July 2026). At AICT, I built a Fake News Detection training project using NLP and TF-IDF and earned O grade in the associated industrial training course.
I currently work as a Jr. Web Developer (Backend) at RIZ Software Consultancy in Kolkata, having joined on 16 September 2026.
